5287.title: [skia-sync] Adopt Chrome M152 failed-flush cache fix
5287.body:
[skia-sync] Adopt Chrome M152 failed-flush cache fix (#5287)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/395
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5294
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/ed63096f86c573cf06efc3565baf5b24d7290187...81b0e06342b1c55e0601afe372a5338da8d82baa

Update release/4.152.x to the merged Ganesh failed-flush cache correction.
Cache entries published before rendering can point to uninitialized
textures when render-task execution, instantiation, or preFlush fails.
The native fix drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries when
fAllTasksSuccessful is false, preventing subsequent cache hits on those
evicted entries. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.

Pin externals/skia and its cgmanifest registration to the actual native
release-branch merge:
81b0e06342b1c55e0601afe372a5338da8d82baa

That two-parent merge contains the reviewed native head
2729c9098d97370ea785504cf47ad4a8e67869f1 and has the same tree. Record
747cf654ed6f864f4402e7d6eb54a6ede60141e5 as the upstream merge commit,
retaining chrome/m152 as the upstream ref and milestone.

The parent diff changes only the gitlink and manifest pins. The native
range changes the failed-flush cleanup and its View/Verts regression
expectations, with no C API or DEPS changes. Package version files and
managed APIs remain unchanged.

Independent regeneration matched the four Skia interop outputs. The
broader generator check also exposed existing HarfBuzz binding drift;
this update does not change that dependency or its managed bindings.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
